behavior: .github/workflows/ci.yml includes a test-windows job on windows-latest
Job runs setup-windows.ps1 end-to-end under PS 5.1 (BUG-005 re-exec path) and exits 0
Job runs healthcheck.ps1 and exits 0 (BUG-015 probe SKIPs on a never-ran-Claude machine)
verification: grep -q 'healthcheck.ps1' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'claude-mem hook probe n/a' scripts/healthcheck.ps1 && grep -q 'claude-mem hook probe n/a' scripts/healthcheck.sh

behavior: Job runs the named PowerShell bats subset (7 files) pinned to versions.conf BATS_VERSION
verification: for f in powershell-profile profile-heal-ps1 setup-windows init-project-ps1 knowledge-crystallize-ps1 obs-cli-ps1 healthcheck-ps1; do grep -q "tests/$f.bats" .github/workflows/ci.yml || exit 1; done

behavior: Job runs the Pester suites (tests/*.Tests.ps1) on windows-latest
test-windows is a required status check in branch protection for main (post-merge, repo admin)
Total CI wall-time increase <= 7 minutes (measured on the first green PR run)
verification: gh run list --repo mlorentedev/dotfiles --workflow CI --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId' | xargs -I{} gh run view {} --repo mlorentedev/dotfiles --json jobs --jq '[.jobs[] | select(.name=="test-windows")][0].startedAt'
